description:
Native (ETH) and ERC-20 balances for an address on an EVM chain.

chain defaults to "base". ERC-20 balances are returned only for the
contracts named in token_addresses -- an EVM RPC endpoint cannot enumerate
a wallet's tokens, and guessing from a fixed list would under-report.

Free (no technology service fee) -- a read with no transaction notional.
name: evm_balances
